name: John Hunt Park
summary: A run recorded with a Garmin watch in and around John Hunt Park on October 17, 2026.
notes: This is one recorded training run, not a measured or official race course. It starts along a straight path, makes several loops, and comes back along part of the same path.
The location was checked only against the park's published parking-lot coordinates. The exact paths were not independently verified.

elevation.method: Smoothed with a 5-point moving average, then every rise and fall added up. An estimate from a watch's elevation sensor.
